[P2] Complete coverage for input-validation branches

Every score fixture uses non-empty string entries, so deleting this validation leaves all assertions unchanged. The non-array guards in `validateScale` and `validateOptions`, and the `serializeInput` branch where `JSON.stringify` returns `undefined`, likewise lack rejecting test cases. These branches enforce rejection before creating a durable operation, but remain unprotected under CONTRIBUTING rule 4. Return to the validation/test design and require these cases to assert the expected error, zero operations, and zero model calls.
